import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    MOD = 998244353
    
    total_edges = n * (n - 1) // 2
    total_colorings = pow(2, total_edges, MOD)
    
    # Subtract the two invalid colorings: all red and all blue
    result = (total_colorings - 2) % MOD
    
    print(result)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
